nom: Seoul Ceuticals Korean Skin Care Exfoliating Toner for Oily, Acne-Prone Skin

segments.oily: One reviewer with very oily skin reports the toner dried her skin slightly but found it manageable, alongside overall brightening.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers describe sensitive skin; most report no irritation or burning, though one experienced redness when using it twice daily and resolved it by switching to nightly use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for lines and wrinkles report fading lines, firmer-feeling skin, and help with wrinkles, with no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer reports lessened dryness alongside dark spot fading; another with very oily skin notes slight drying that she considers manageable.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports her skin became red when using the product twice a day, but irritation resolved once she switched to nightly application; other reviewers, including other sensitive-skin users, report no redness or burning.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers mention no irritation or burning as a positive, suggesting the product is tolerated well, though this overlaps with the one dissenting redness report.
concerns.spots: Numerous reviewers report fading, lightening, or disappearance of dark spots, age spots, sunspots, and freckles over one to several weeks of use; one notes spots on the forehead were more stubborn but still lightened.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports her blemish became less dark and her complexion improved; no negative reports on breakouts appear.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with very oily skin reports slight drying of the skin with continued use, describing it as manageable rather than problematic.

extraits.texte: Ive used this product for 4 weeks. I started noticing a difference a couple weeks ago as my blemish wasnt as dark. Initially I used it twice a day, but I have sensitive skin and it became red. I now use it nightly and have no irritation.
I am shocked!!! After a little over a week my dark spots have nearly disappeared, my skin looks brighter and the dryness has lessened!! I'm a customer for life!!!
So far, so good! I have been using it for 2 weeks and I see notable difference. I have very oily face and this has dried a little bit but somehow manageable.

extraits.titre: Love the smooth look of my skin
extraits.texte: Very nice product. I have sensitive skin and this product does not irritate at all. It leaves my skin smooth and feeling loved.
Works great,saw quick results I'm very happy with the product. I didn't have any issues with burning, redness or anything like that. Totally recommend!
I love how this toner makes my skin feel energized. I have sensitive skin and most hyaluronic products don't absorb as well as this.
I like that it absorbs quickly and seems to help with my wrinkles.
